text: Based on the output from NASA FIRMS active fire detections between October 4 and November 3, 2026, no fires were detected near **ASSET-F08**. The analysis checked data from four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS), all of which covered the asset’s location during the period. No thermal anomalies or fire activity intersected with the asset. Therefore, **the asset was not affected by fire in this timeframe**.
